{{Infobox character|name=Oathmother Hild|house=[[House Stonebear]]|role=Keeper of the rite|age=~76}}
'''Oathmother Hild''' guards the rite at the Wall of Shame's nameless line — the only living person who knows the words. Whether she remembers the oath itself, or repeats a rite whose meaning was lost generations ago, no one can say.
